name: Coldplay

whyMatters.en: London four-piece formed in 1996. Delay guitar, piano hooks, and mid-tempo songs on Parachutes (2000) and A Rush of Blood to the Head (2002) put the band on early-2000s alternative radio.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦四人组，1996 年成立。Parachutes（2000）与 A Rush of Blood to the Head（2002）以延时吉他、钢琴钩子与中速歌曲进入 2000 年代初 alternative 电台。

lyricQuotes: Look at the stars / Look how they shine for you
Lights will guide you home / And ignite your bones

shortBio.en: Chris Martin–led four-piece; Yellow and Clocks established piano and delay guitar on mass alternative radio; Viva la Vida (2008) with Brian Eno expanded the arrangement scale.
shortBio.zh: Chris Martin 领衔四人组；Yellow 与 Clocks 把钢琴与延时吉他送上大众 alternative 电台；Viva la Vida（2008，Brian Eno）扩大编曲规模。

body.en:
Formed in 1996 at University College London. Parachutes (2000, produced by Ken Nelson) set Buckland’s delay arpeggios, Martin’s falsetto, and mid-tempo song shapes; Yellow was the debut single marker. A Rush of Blood to the Head (2002) added Clocks’s piano ostinato and The Scientist’s ballad dynamics.

Later albums with Brian Eno—including Viva la Vida or Death and All His Friends (2008) and Mylo Xyloto (2011)—used larger arrangements and brighter production. The early catalog is the main reference for the band’s post-Britpop alternative sound.
body.zh:
1996 年于伦敦大学学院组建。Parachutes（2000，Ken Nelson 制作）确立 Buckland 的延时琶音、Martin 的假声与中速歌曲形态；Yellow 是出道单曲标记。A Rush of Blood to the Head（2002）加入 Clocks 的钢琴 ostinato 与 The Scientist 的抒情动态。

后期与 Brian Eno 合作的专辑——包括 Viva la Vida or Death and All His Friends（2008）与 Mylo Xyloto（2011）——编曲更大、制作更亮。早期目录是乐队后 Britpop alternative 声音的主要参照。

note.zh: Parachutes 出道单曲；Buckland 延时吉他与 Martin 假声。

note.en: Piano ostinato hook from A Rush of Blood to the Head; US chart breakthrough.
note.zh: 出自 A Rush of Blood to the Head 的钢琴 ostinato 钩子；美国榜单突破。

note.en: Piano ballad; reverse-playback video; quieter dynamic range than Clocks.
note.zh: 钢琴谣曲；倒放 MV；动态比 Clocks 更安静。

title.en: Piano and delay on alternative radio
title.zh: 钢琴与延时上 alternative 电台

body.en:
Yellow and Clocks use Buckland’s dotted-delay guitar, Martin’s falsetto, and a steady Berryman/Champion pulse. Lyrics sit at mid-tempo; the guitar parts stay clearer than shoegaze wash.

A Rush of Blood to the Head (2002) fixed that writing before the Eno-era albums widened the palette.
body.zh:
Yellow 与 Clocks 使用 Buckland 的点延时吉他、Martin 的假声，以及 Berryman/Champion 的稳定脉冲。歌词落在中速；吉他比 shoegaze 铺底更清晰。

A Rush of Blood to the Head（2002）在 Eno 时期扩编前固定了这套写法。

body.en:
Martin, Buckland, and Berryman formed the group; Champion joined on drums in 1997. The same four names appear from Parachutes through later stadium tours.

Live shows add keyboardists; primary writing remains Martin and Buckland.
body.zh:
Martin、Buckland、Berryman 组建乐队；Champion 于 1997 年加入鼓。从 Parachutes 到后期体育场巡演仍是这四个名字。

现场会加键盘手；主要写作仍是 Martin 与 Buckland。

body.en:
Coldplay and Radiohead came from the same UK generation; Coldplay kept verse/chorus songs at large-venue scale while Radiohead moved further into experimental and electronic work. Later albums draw on U2/Eno-style production.

Early records are often cited by 2000s piano-led alternative bands.
body.zh:
Coldplay 与 Radiohead 同属一代英国乐队；Coldplay 维持适合大型场地的主副歌写法，Radiohead 则更多进入实验与电子。后期专辑吸收 U2/Eno 式制作。

早期唱片常被 2000 年代钢琴导向的 alternative 乐队引用。

interviewQuotes.text: The piano and the delay guitar are the band's signature, not the wardrobe.
